spans.s: ज्यौतिष, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.

ज्यौतिषिक, अस्, m. one who knows the Jyotiṣa,
an astronomer, astrologer.

ज्यौत्स्न, अस्, ई, अम्, luminous especially with
moonlight; (अस्), m. the time of moonlight, the
light half of a month; (ई), f. a full moon night; N.
of a plant, = पटोलिका.

ज्यौत्स्निका, f. a moonlight night; (perhaps an
incorrect form for ज्योत्स्निका.)

ज्यौ ज्यौ, औस्, m. (a word borrowed fr. the
Gr. Ζεύς), the planet Jupiter.
